question: What practice concerning the soul is being declared as told to the addressee Bhairavī?
premises: This is indicated as the thing in question.
The practice of the soul is told to you.
The statement is made in the present declaration.
inference: The practice of the soul has been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of that practice is not repeated in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
